gui.essenceindustry.port.energy_help: Active moves energy to or from the adjacent block. The machine determines direction: generators output; fuel processors input. Passive leaves transfer to external cables.
gui.essenceindustry.port.direction_pendi: Form the machine to determine direction
gui.essenceindustry.fuel_ui.queue_help: Ready counts complete batches in the input buffer. One batch of each ready recipe runs in turn; incomplete recipes wait. Energy and output space may pause processing.
tooltip.essenceindustry.block_accelerato: Mounts on an ME cable and accelerates the adjacent machine facing its plate.
tooltip.essenceindustry.quantum_module.v: Staff: breaks up to 16 additional connected matching blocks per module. Takes priority over Area Mining. Hold Shift to mine one block.
tooltip.essenceindustry.quantum_module.s: Staff: +20 percentage points of underwater mining efficiency. Four modules remove the usual underwater penalty.
